To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the total energy of microRNA-mRNA hybridization is a predictive feature for miRNA target prediction but that this feature adds only a small amount to the total accuracy using expression features alone.

GenMiR3 is a novel model and learning algorithm that uses sequence and expression data to score candidate miRNA-mRNAs interactions and the only sequence feature predictive of expression is total hybridization energy between the miRNA and mRNA.

(1) GenMiR3 outperforms other methods for predicting miRNA-mRNA target pairs using both expression and sequence data and (2) the total energy of miRNA-mRNA hybridization is the only sequence feature that adds significant information to the GenMiR3 prediction model when expression is used.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to best combine expression and sequence features to predict miRNA targets.
the development and testing of new algorithms for predicting miRNA-mRNA targets using both sequence and expression data.

developing a model for predicting miRNA-target interactions that takes into account both sequence and expression features and that is able to identify the features that are most important for prediction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GenMiR3 model is the most accurate model of miRNA target prediction to date but the inclusion of sequence features does not improve the model.
expression features alone are sufficient to accurately predict microRNA targets and that sequence features are not predictive of expression features.
the expression features alone are sufficient to make accurate predictions and that the sequence features do not add much value.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
expression features alone are sufficient for predicting miRNA-mRNA interaction.
the sequence features we considered do not improve the performance of GenMiR predictions using paired mRNA and miR expression profiles.
GenMiR3 is a useful tool to predict miRNA target interactions but that sequence features do not add much predictive power to expression based methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sequence-based methods are not useful for predicting microRNA targets using paired expression data.
sequence features alone are not sufficient to identify biologically relevant miRNA-mRNA interaction and that the expression features are more predictive of miRNA-mRNA targets.

GenMiR3 provides a framework for incorporating sequence features into a machine learning model for predicting miRNA interactions and that this model is robust enough to tolerate the inclusion of features with little predictive power.
